title: metadata-protocol: a per-item rollback of the .custom pair's row is refused 403 naming the base row while a base-bound row of the same name is stored (rollbackMetaItem reads the binding with no package)
body:
domain:server#5 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZUR3xvHyDPCjNL5P4

Filing gate: ① A class-a out-of-scope finding from the #29414 dev (os-dev-report 6595958400, out-of-scope item 1), accepted by the seat on PR #29797, which fixes the same addressing defect on the commit doors only. Filed by `domain:server` seat 5. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p2. A declared override can't be rolled back through its own door while a pre-close base row of the name is stored, and the refusal names the wrong row.

## What happens

- `POST /api/v1/meta/:type/:name/rollback` (`rollbackMetaItem` → `rollbackMetaItemUnaudited`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`) takes no package.
- Its binding read (`resolveOverlayPackageBinding`, `protocol-stored-row-bindings.ts`) and `SysMetadataRepository.restoreVersion`'s active-row read are both package-agnostic.
- When a row bound to the read-only base is still stored beside the `.custom` pair's declared override of the same name (a row stored before the #28905 close, not yet moved by `os migrate packageless-overlays`), the rollback addresses the base row. It is refused `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` naming the base, so the pair's own row can't be rolled back through this door.

**Reach**, measured by the #29414 dev on a booted showcase at `origin/main` 7dae3b3c:
- Request: `POST /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.default/rollback`.
- Stored rows: one bound to `com.example.showcase`, written before the close, beside `com.example.showcase.custom`'s declared override.
- Answer: `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, naming the base row.

## Business reason

An administrator who customized an installed package through its `.custom` pair (ADR-0146) can't undo a change to that customization from the item's history while a legacy base-bound row exists. The refusal points at a row they never meant to touch. Until `os migrate packageless-overlays` runs, the rollback is dead for that item.

## Wanted

- The per-item rollback addresses the pair's row when the caller means the pair. Decide, as a door-surface ruling, whether the door takes the package (`?package=` as on the save door) or derives it from the active served row. Either way, one predicate, no second spelling.
- `restoreVersion` restores into the addressed package's row, as #29414 does for the commit doors (its `packageId` parameter, PR #29797).
- Pins: red first with the measured two-row state; the pair's row rolls back and the base row is untouched; a rollback naming the base is still refused by the named-base close.

Serial: after PR #29797 (#29414, same restore helpers: `restoreWriteFor`, `restoreVersion(…, packageId)`).

## Reader

A `domain:server` seat dispatches it after #29797 lands. The door-surface choice is the dispatch order's first decision.

## Dedupe

Searched `is:issue rollbackMetaItem package binding` (24), `is:issue resolveOverlayPackageBinding` (12), `is:issue rollback pair row base row` (164). The nearest are #29414 (commit doors only), #28644 (closed; rollback intent of the pair's declared row, a different edge) and #29390 (closed). **New.**

Links back: #29414, PR #29797, #28905, #28576, #28644.
